encounters.description: A cracked sanctum shrine still burns with a god's spoiled light. An angel might leave an offering here to learn what the fallen still demand.

choices.description: Bleed a little of your light into the shrine.
Pass without kneeling.

encounters.description: Water wells from broken stone where a sanctum once washed the wounded. An angel could drink and rise again for the climb ahead.

choices.description: Drink from the spring.
Leave the water for whatever still wanders here.

encounters.description: Under loose flagstones you find a sanctum cache left by servants who never returned. An angel might claim what they meant for the climb.

choices.description: Take the coins from the cache.
Claim the iron oath tablet sealed inside.
Leave the cache buried.

encounters.description: A faded attendant still tends the hurt along the sanctum road, following orders that once meant mercy. An angel could accept that help without asking who gives it.

choices.description: Buy the attendant's restorative draught.
Accept a spare bandage for the road.
Decline and continue the climb.

encounters.description: A flooded sanctum court bars the way upward. An angel must choose how to cross without abandoning the path.

choices.description: Pay a silent ferryman for safe passage.
Wade the flood alone.
Wait for the waters to sink.

encounters.description: Beneath the sanctum, old workings still hold relics of the fallen. An angel might risk the dark for tools of release.

choices.description: Search the unstable tunnels for valuables.
Pull a doom sigil free from the wall.
Leave the workings closed.

encounters.description: A hooded servant still tests travellers with an old sanctum riddle. An angel who answers may earn coin—or a sealed rite instead.

choices.description: Answer the riddle for coin.
Accept a sealed pact in place of coin.
Walk on without answering.

encounters.description: A sanctum alchemist still mixes reagents from the corruption itself. An angel might trade for poison—or take a purifying draught.

choices.description: Trade coins for a poison flask.
Accept a purifying tincture for free.
Refuse the bargains.
